mentions.name: cafe.io
mentions.description: A DNS service for AWS EC2 that handles ever-changing instance IPs. It fetches instance IPs regularly via the AWS API and assigns them to fixed subdomains, useful when Elastic IPs can't be used (e.g., with Auto Scaling Groups) or when users don't want third-party clients installed on their instances.
mentions.problem: EC2 instance IPs constantly change and can't be pinned down when Elastic IPs can't be used (e.g., with Auto Scaling Groups) and installing third-party clients on instances isn't an option.
mentions.source_excerpt:
It is a DNS service for AWS EC2 to keep the ever changing IPs when you cannot use the Elastic IP like ASG or when you don't want to install any third party clients to your instances.

It fetches the IPs regularly via AWS API and assign them to fixed subdomains.

evidence.value:
It is a DNS service for AWS EC2 to keep the ever changing IPs when you cannot use the Elastic IP like ASG or when you don't want to install any third party clients to your instances.

It fetches the IPs regularly via AWS API and assign them to fixed subdomains.
evidence.author: emrekutlu
